speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
text: An overview of the various admission pathways into Nursing programmes at the IHLs is available on MOH Holdings’ Care to Go Beyond website.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Information on each IHL’s admission processes and requirements can also be found on their respective websites.

speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: Can she provide an	 update on the nursing manpower situation in our local restructured hospitals?

speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: And based on her reply, only 15 students entered Nursing programmes from the IBDP and IP.

speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: What more can be done to encourage more students to take up nursing from these educational routes?

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: In respect of getting the numbers from the local institutions, we are doing a few things.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: We are doing different efforts on different fronts.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: Hopefully, in time, this will improve the manpower situation.
